positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE, FireOS Framework Architecture
- refactor and redesign various system components in FireOS
- device tree configuration and clean-up to support all Amazon devices under one common OS

SDE, FireOS Performance Analytics
- design and develop device health metrics monitoring framework with auto-correction feature, patent granted
- implement core system health and performance metrics
- collaborate with various other teams to come up with a customized dashboard with executive views and adjustable individual team views
- power consumption modeling framework utilizing system events
- various performance tools

SDE, Firephone Platform
Factory Diagnostics:
- design and implement factory diagnostics software for embedded device. 
- work with hardware, operation, and vendors to optimize factory run
- debug and resolve issues in factory

Device Performance:
- design and implement instrumentation and performance metrics framework
- implement system level performance instrumentation with a strong focus on user experience
- device performance improvements through data-driven analysis

positions.title: Senior Engineer
